spam.name: Spam
spam.description: Repeated, pointless or bulk comments that clutter your posts.

scam_phishing.name: Scam or phishing
scam_phishing.description: Fake offers, giveaways and links that try to steal money or login details.

harassment_abuse.name: Harassment or abuse
harassment_abuse.description: Insults, threats and attacks aimed at you, your team or other commenters.

hate_speech.name: Hate speech
hate_speech.description: Comments that attack people for who they are, such as their race, religion or gender.

sexual_content.name: Sexual content
sexual_content.description: Explicit or sexually suggestive comments that do not belong on your page.

profanity.name: Profanity
profanity.description: Swearing and crude language, even when it is not aimed at anyone.

self_promotion.name: Self-promotion
self_promotion.description: People advertising their own page, product or channel in your comments.

action.flag: Flag it for a person to review

defaults.intro: Choose what FeedBouncer does when it spots each kind of comment. You can change this any time in the classifier settings.
defaults.aiOff: The AI classifier is not switched on for this server, so these choices will start working once it is. You can still set them now.
defaults.removeNote: These comments are removed by your classifier settings, so there is nothing to pick here. <link>Open classifier settings</link>
defaults.saveFailed: Could not save your choices. Try again.

reviewMode.intro: Decide how cautious FeedBouncer should be when it first starts acting on comments.

review.label: Review first (recommended)
review.body: For the first 7 days after each account connects, FeedBouncer only suggests actions. Flagged comments stay visible until someone approves the suggestion in the review queue, and after that it acts on the choices from the previous step.

automatic.label: Act automatically
automatic.body: FeedBouncer hides comments right away using the choices from the previous step. Every action is logged with its reason and can be undone from Hidden today.

reviewMode.reviewUnavailable: Review first is not available because review has already ended on your connected accounts.
reviewMode.acknowledge: I understand that FeedBouncer will start hiding comments right away, and that a mistake can affect real people before I notice.
reviewMode.saveFailed: Could not save your choice. Try again.

report.syncing: {count, plural, one {Imported # comment so far} other {Imported # comments so far}}
report.syncFailed: Could not refresh the numbers. We will try again.
report.empty: No comments yet. New comments are checked within about a minute, and results appear here and in the weekly report on Monday. Imported history is shown for context, but it is not checked.
report.noConnections: No accounts are connected yet. Go back to connect one.
report.finishFailed: Could not finish setup. Try again.
report.done: Setup is finished. FeedBouncer is now working on your comments. <dashboard>Go to your dashboard</dashboard>
